description: sd CLI: 'sd show <id> --format json' nests fields under .issue (issue.description), not top-level. A naive python/jq access to top-level .description yields empty and piping that into 'sd update --description' WIPES the seed body. Always read .issue.description; verify non-empty before writing. Recovery: seeds are git-native — restore from 'git show HEAD:.seeds/issues.jsonl' and append the intended note.
resolution: Recovered all three seeds from git show HEAD:.seeds/issues.jsonl and appended notes; description reads must use .issue.description and assert non-empty before sd update.

description: Adding query params to an existing OpenAPI operation inserts POSITIONAL params in the generated TS client (runs-api.ts listRuns) — every web call site breaks typecheck with confusing 'BoardColumn[] not assignable to string' errors. After any spec change: bun run generate, then grep apps/fabro-web for the changed operation and pad call sites before typecheck.
resolution: queries.ts call sites updated with two positional undefineds before status; verified by bun run typecheck.

description: Two e2e traps (fabro-47b5 cycle): (1) tests/it's LlmCodergenBackend is a plain completion seam (tools: None) — it never builds agent sessions, so session-level features (tool policies, agent.tools.available) are silently untested through it; (2) cargo nextest --profile e2e sets NEXTEST_PROFILE=e2e => TestMode::Strict, which SKIPS twin-only tests (e2e_test(twin) prints 'skipping' and returns Ok) — a green e2e-profile run can be a no-op. Always run twin tests in the default profile (or with FABRO_TEST_MODE=twin) and prefer httpmock + real AgentApiBackend for wire-level proofs.
resolution: Replaced with an httpmock integration test that drives the real AgentApiBackend and asserts on the wire request body; runs deterministically in the default profile.
